newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-ZENIT ST PETERSBURG WIN SPONSORSHIP DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZENIT ST PETERSBURG WIN SPONSORSHIP DEAL.

text.p: Surgutneftegaz, one of Russia's biggest oil companies, have sealed a sponsorship agreement with premier league Zenit St Petersburg, a company spokeswoman said on Friday.
Under the 1.5-billion-rouble ($270,000) deal, Zenit will advertise the oil company on programmes, tickets, posters and some other club material but not on shirts.

"Russian soccer was born in St Petersburg and we consider it our duty to provide our assistance to Zenit to improve its sports facilities," Raisa Khotchenko, deputy commercial director of Surgutneftegaz, told Reuters by telephone.
Russian soccer clubs are increasingly striking sponsorship deals to see them through cash problems.
Zenit finished 10th in the league last season, too low to receive a financial bonus which the local authorities had promised if the team finished in the top eight.
Zenit have appointed a new coach, Anatoly Byshovets, to replace Pavel Sadyrin. But Byshovets complained last week that Sadyrin had taken the best Zenit players to his new club, CSKA Moscow.
